response.answer: The original RAG retriever uses DPR, which follows a bi-encoder architecture with a BERTBASE document encoder and a BERTBASE query encoder [2]. DPR produces a dense representation d(z) of a document from the BERTBASE document encoder and a query representation q(x) from the query encoder, also based on BERTBASE [2]. The passages do not specify what token representation DPR extracts from each encoder; the passage stating use of the [CLS] token representation (d = 768) describes the encoders in 2004.04906v3, not DPR [1].
